text:
Situation: Warfarin sodium is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 272 tablets of the 6 mg presentation at 10.5 tablets per day, providing 26 days on hand. Corvale General holds 189 tablets of the 6 mg presentation at 10 tablets per day, providing 18.8 days on hand, and 266 tablets of the 2 mg presentation at 10.7 tablets per day, providing 24.9 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 18 tablets of the 6 mg presentation at 7 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows warfarin sodium is not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory at Corvale Lakeside is critically low at 7 days. Corvale General 6 mg stock is below 20 days. Proactive purchasing is warranted to prevent shortage at individual sites despite no national shortage listing.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to execute purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC for 6 mg tablets to replenish Corvale Lakeside and Corvale General; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to execute purchase from Exelan Pharmaceuticals Inc. as secondary source for 6 mg tablets if Amneal allocation is limited; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate 2 mg tablet needs at Corvale General and purchase from Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Inc. if indicated; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. and Upsher-Smith Laboratories, LLC availability as backup options; requires Pharmacy Director approval for any purchase.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
